targets.old_statement: A 15-year-old with a valid learner license may drive only with a parent, a legal guardian, or a licensed driver 21 or older seated in front beside them.
targets.old_spoken_statement: A fifteen-year-old with a valid learner license may drive only with a parent, a legal guardian, or a licensed driver twenty-one or older seated in front beside them.
targets.statement: A fifteen-year-old holding a valid learner license may drive only when a parent, legal guardian, licensed driver aged twenty-one or older, or licensed or certified driving instructor occupies the front seat beside the driver.

targets.old_statement: The late-night exceptions are riding with a licensee 21 or older with parental consent, or driving because of a medical, fire or law enforcement emergency.
targets.old_spoken_statement: The late-night exceptions are riding with a licensee twenty-one or older with parental consent, or driving because of a medical, fire or law enforcement emergency.
targets.statement: A restricted young driver may not operate a vehicle from midnight to six a.m. unless accompanied by a parent or legal guardian, riding with a licensed driver twenty-one or older with parental consent, traveling to or from regular work or a school- or religious-sponsored event, or driving for a medical, fire, or law-enforcement emergency.
